match_stages.stage_briefing:
Cross Road Blues is a 14 round Comstock course. There are 7 USPSA cardboard targets.
The start position is heels touching marks.
Handgun loaded and holstered, wrists below belt.
PCC is loaded with safety on, stock on belt, muzzle generally downrange.
Upon the audible start signal engage targets from within the shooting area.
